data.name: Blue Planet
data.description: Blue Planet Systems is a Silicon Valley-based carbon capture and mineralization company founded in 2013. Its patented Geomimetic® process converts captured CO2 into synthetic limestone aggregate for use in concrete, permanently sequestering carbon in the built environment. The company operates a demonstration plant in Pittsburg, California and is scaling up commercial production.
